Perfection and Praise of the word of God
Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
My heart, O God, is steadfast;
    I will sing and make music with all my soul.

teaching.name: Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
Who will bring me to the fortified city?
    Who will lead me to Edom?

teaching.name: Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
Is it not you, God, you who have rejected us
    and no longer go out with our armies?

teaching.name: Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
Give us aid against the enemy,
    for human help is worthless.

teaching.name: Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
With God we will gain the victory,
    and he will trample down our enemies.

teaching.name: Perfection and Praise of the word of God

content:
In return for my friendship they accuse me,
    but I am a man of prayer.

May his children be fatherless
    and his wife a widow.

For he never thought of doing a kindness,
    but hounded to death the poor
    and the needy and the brokenhearted.

May this be the Lord’s payment to my accusers,
    to those who speak evil of me.

I fade away like an evening shadow;
    I am shaken off like a locust.

Help me, Lord my God;
    save me according to your unfailing love.

For he stands at the right hand of the needy,
    to save their lives from those who would condemn them.

They repay me evil for good,
    and hatred for my friendship.

Appoint someone evil to oppose my enemy;
    let an accuser stand at his right hand.

May a creditor seize all he has;
    may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord;
    may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

My God, whom I praise,
    do not remain silent,

With words of hatred they surround me;
    they attack me without cause.

When he is tried, let him be found guilty,
    and may his prayers condemn him.

May his days be few;
    may another take his place of leadership.

May his children be wandering beggars;
    may they be driven from their ruined homes.

May no one extend kindness to him
    or take pity on his fatherless children.

May his descendants be cut off,
    their names blotted out from the next generation.

May their sins always remain before the Lord,
    that he may blot out their name from the earth.

May it be like a cloak wrapped about him,
    like a belt tied forever around him.

For I am poor and needy,
    and my heart is wounded within me.

With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord;
    in the great throng of worshipers I will praise him.

He loved to pronounce a curse—
    may it come back on him.
  He found no pleasure in blessing—
    may it be far from him.

My knees give way from fasting;
    my body is thin and gaunt.

I am an object of scorn to my accusers;
    when they see me, they shake their heads.

Let them know that it is your hand,
    that you, Lord, have done it.

May my accusers be clothed with disgrace
    and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

In the Lord I take refuge.
    How then can you say to me:
    “Flee like a bird to your mountain.

When the foundations are being destroyed,
    what can the righteous do?”

For look, the wicked bend their bows;
    they set their arrows against the strings
  to shoot from the shadows
    at the upright in heart.

The Lord examines the righteous,
    but the wicked, those who love violence,
    he hates with a passion.

The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion, saying,
    “Rule in the midst of your enemies!”

Your troops will be willing
    on your day of battle.
  Arrayed in holy splendor,
    your young men will come to you
    like dew from the morning’s womb.

The Lord says to my lord:
    
  “Sit at my right hand
    until I make your enemies
    a footstool for your feet.”

The Lord is at your right hand;
    he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead
    and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

He will drink from a brook along the way,
    and so he will lift his head high.

The Lord has sworn
    and will not change his mind:
  “You are a priest forever,
    in the order of Melchizedek.”

He has caused his wonders to be remembered;
    the Lord is gracious and compassionate.

Praise the Lord.
    
  I will extol the Lord with all my heart
    in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

He has shown his people the power of his works,
    giving them the lands of other nations.

Glorious and majestic are his deeds,
    and his righteousness endures forever.

They are established for ever and ever,
    enacted in faithfulness and uprightness.

Great are the works of the Lord;
    they are pondered by all who delight in them.

He provides food for those who fear him;
    he remembers his covenant forever.

The works of his hands are faithful and just;
    all his precepts are trustworthy.

Their children will be mighty in the land;
    the generation of the upright will be blessed.

Even in darkness light dawns for the upright,
    for those who are gracious and compassionate and righteous.

Good will come to those who are generous and lend freely,
    who conduct their affairs with justice.

They will have no fear of bad news;
    their hearts are steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

Their hearts are secure, they will have no fear;
    in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.

Praise the Lord.
    
  Blessed are those who fear the Lord,
    who find great delight in his commands.

Surely the righteous will never be shaken;
    they will be remembered forever.

Wealth and riches are in their houses,
    and their righteousness endures forever.

Who is like the Lord our God,
    the One who sits enthroned on high,

He settles the childless woman in her home
    as a happy mother of children.
    
  Praise the Lord.

From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets,
    the name of the Lord is to be praised.

he seats them with princes,
    with the princes of his people.

The Lord is exalted over all the nations,
    his glory above the heavens.

who stoops down to look
    on the heavens and the earth?

He raises the poor from the dust
    and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

Let the name of the Lord be praised,
    both now and forevermore.

the mountains leaped like rams,
    the hills like lambs.

Why, mountains, did you leap like rams,
    you hills, like lambs?

who turned the rock into a pool,
    the hard rock into springs of water.

When Israel came out of Egypt,
    Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

Judah became God’s sanctuary,
    Israel his dominion.

The sea looked and fled,
    the Jordan turned back;

Why was it, sea, that you fled?
    Why, Jordan, did you turn back?

Tremble, earth, at the presence of the Lord,
    at the presence of the God of Jacob,

he will bless those who fear the Lord—
    small and great alike.

They have mouths, but cannot speak,
    eyes, but cannot see.

Those who make them will be like them,
    and so will all who trust in them.

All you Israelites, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

The Lord remembers us and will bless us:
    He will bless his people Israel,
    he will bless the house of Aaron,

It is not the dead who praise the Lord,
    those who go down to the place of silence;

it is we who extol the Lord,
    both now and forevermore.
    
  Praise the Lord.

Not to us, Lord, not to us
    but to your name be the glory,
    because of your love and faithfulness.

Why do the nations say,
    “Where is their God?”

Our God is in heaven;
    he does whatever pleases him.

They have ears, but cannot hear,
    noses, but cannot smell.

They have hands, but cannot feel,
    feet, but cannot walk,
    nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

You who fear him, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

The highest heavens belong to the Lord,
    but the earth he has given to mankind.

But their idols are silver and gold,
    made by human hands.

House of Aaron, trust in the Lord—
    he is their help and shield.

May the Lord cause you to flourish,
    both you and your children.

May you be blessed by the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

Because he turned his ear to me,
    I will call on him as long as I live.

Then I called on the name of the Lord:
    “Lord, save me!”

The Lord is gracious and righteous;
    our God is full of compassion.

that I may walk before the Lord
    in the land of the living.

I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
    in the presence of all his people.

in the courts of the house of the Lord—
    in your midst, Jerusalem.
    
  Praise the Lord.

For you, Lord, have delivered me from death,
    my eyes from tears,
    my feet from stumbling,

Precious in the sight of the Lord
    is the death of his faithful servants.

I will fulfill my vows to the Lord
    in the presence of all his people,

I love the Lord, for he heard my voice;
    he heard my cry for mercy.

The Lord protects the unwary;
    when I was brought low, he saved me.

Return to your rest, my soul,
    for the Lord has been good to you.

I trusted in the Lord when I said,
    “I am greatly afflicted”;

in my alarm I said,
    “Everyone is a liar.”

What shall I return to the Lord
    for all his goodness to me?

I will lift up the cup of salvation
    and call on the name of the Lord.

I will sacrifice a thank offering to you
    and call on the name of the Lord.

For great is his love toward us,
    and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever.
    
  Praise the Lord.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Praise the Lord, all you nations;
    extol him, all you peoples.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
    his love endures forever.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Let Israel say:
    “His love endures forever.”

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Let those who fear the Lord say:
    “His love endures forever.”

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
When hard pressed, I cried to the Lord;
    he brought me into a spacious place.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord is with me; he is my helper.
    I look in triumph on my enemies.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
It is better to take refuge in the Lord
    than to trust in princes.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord is God,
    and he has made his light shine on us.
  With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession
    up to the horns of the altar.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Let the house of Aaron say:
    “His love endures forever.”

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
It is better to take refuge in the Lord
    than to trust in humans.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God
Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
I was pushed back and about to fall,
    but the Lord helped me.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Shouts of joy and victory
    resound in the tents of the righteous:
  “The Lord’s right hand has done mighty things!

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord has chastened me severely,
    but he has not given me over to death.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
I will give you thanks, for you answered me;
    you have become my salvation.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
the Lord has done this,
    and it is marvelous in our eyes.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
    From the house of the Lord we bless you.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
    his love endures forever.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid.
    What can mere mortals do to me?

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
All the nations surrounded me,
    but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord’s right hand is lifted high;
    the Lord’s right hand has done mighty things!”

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Open for me the gates of the righteous;
    I will enter and give thanks to the Lord.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
This is the gate of the Lord
    through which the righteous may enter.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The stone the builders rejected
    has become the cornerstone;

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord has done it this very day;
    let us rejoice today and be glad.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
They surrounded me on every side,
    but in the name of the Lord I cut them down.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
The Lord is my strength and my defense;
    he has become my salvation.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
I will not die but live,
    and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Lord, save us!
    Lord, grant us success!

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
You are my God, and I will praise you;
    you are my God, and I will exalt you.

teaching.name: Hallelujah for the universal praise of God

content:
Blessed are those who keep his statutes
    and seek him with all their heart—

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
With my lips I recount
    all the laws that come from your mouth.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I rejoice in following your statutes
    as one rejoices in great riches.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I am a stranger on earth;
    do not hide your commands from me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You rebuke the arrogant, who are accursed,
    those who stray from your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though rulers sit together and slander me,
    your servant will meditate on your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I am laid low in the dust;
    preserve my life according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I gave an account of my ways and you answered me;
    teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Keep me from deceitful ways;
    be gracious to me and teach me your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I run in the path of your commands,
    for you have broadened my understanding.
    ה He

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Teach me, Lord, the way of your decrees,
    that I may follow it to the end.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
How I long for your precepts!
    In your righteousness preserve my life.
    ו Waw

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May your unfailing love come to me, Lord,
    your salvation, according to your promise;

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Remember your word to your servant,
    for you have given me hope.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My comfort in my suffering is this:
    Your promise preserves my life.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You are my portion, Lord;
    I have promised to obey your words.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Do good to your servant
    according to your word, Lord.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May your unfailing love be my comfort,
    according to your promise to your servant.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May those who fear you turn to me,
    those who understand your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My soul faints with longing for your salvation,
    but I have put my hope in your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The arrogant dig pits to trap me,
    contrary to your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Save me, for I am yours;
    I have sought out your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have more insight than all my teachers,
    for I meditate on your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have not departed from your laws,
    for you yourself have taught me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You are my refuge and my shield;
    I have put my hope in your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have done what is righteous and just;
    do not leave me to my oppressors.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Because I love your commands
    more than gold, more than pure gold,

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I open my mouth and pant,
    longing for your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Turn to me and have mercy on me,
    as you always do to those who love your name.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Make your face shine on your servant
    and teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My zeal wears me out,
    for my enemies ignore your words.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Those who devise wicked schemes are near,
    but they are far from your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Rulers persecute me without cause,
    but my heart trembles at your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May my lips overflow with praise,
    for you teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May my tongue sing of your word,
    for all your commands are righteous.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May your hand be ready to help me,
    for I have chosen your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I long for your salvation, Lord,
    and your law gives me delight.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Blessed are those whose ways are blameless,
    who walk according to the law of the Lord.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Then I would not be put to shame
    when I consider all your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will praise you with an upright heart
    as I learn your righteous laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Praise be to you, Lord;
    teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Open my eyes that I may see
    wonderful things in your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Cause me to understand the way of your precepts,
    that I may meditate on your wonderful deeds.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My soul is weary with sorrow;
    strengthen me according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have sought your face with all my heart;
    be gracious to me according to your promise.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Teach me knowledge and good judgment,
    for I trust your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Let your compassion come to me that I may live,
    for your law is my delight.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause;
    but I will meditate on your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
How long must your servant wait?
    When will you punish my persecutors?

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
They almost wiped me from the earth,
    but I have not forsaken your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your faithfulness continues through all generations;
    you established the earth, and it endures.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The wicked are waiting to destroy me,
    but I will ponder your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have more understanding than the elders,
    for I obey your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
How sweet are your words to my taste,
    sweeter than honey to my mouth!

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have taken an oath and confirmed it,
    that I will follow your righteous laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have suffered much;
    preserve my life, Lord, according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Accept, Lord, the willing praise of my mouth,
    and teach me your laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The wicked have set a snare for me,
    but I have not strayed from your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Sustain me, my God, according to your promise, and I will live;
    do not let my hopes be dashed.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Ensure your servant’s well-being;
    do not let the arrogant oppress me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Deal with your servant according to your love
    and teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
and because I consider all your precepts right,
    I hate every wrong path.
    פ Pe

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Redeem me from human oppression,
    that I may obey your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The statutes you have laid down are righteous;
    they are fully trustworthy.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your promises have been thoroughly tested,
    and your servant loves them.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Trouble and distress have come upon me,
    but your commands give me delight.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I call out to you; save me
    and I will keep your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I rise before dawn and cry for help;
    I have put my hope in your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Long ago I learned from your statutes
    that you established them to last forever.
    ר Resh

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Salvation is far from the wicked,
    for they do not seek out your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your compassion, Lord, is great;
    preserve my life according to your laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Many are the foes who persecute me,
    but I have not turned from your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I look on the faithless with loathing,
    for they do not obey your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
See how I love your precepts;
    preserve my life, Lord, in accordance with your love.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I obey your statutes,
    for I love them greatly.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May my cry come before you, Lord;
    give me understanding according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You have laid down precepts
    that are to be fully obeyed.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Oh, that my ways were steadfast
    in obeying your decrees!

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I seek you with all my heart;
    do not let me stray from your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have hidden your word in my heart
    that I might not sin against you.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My soul is consumed with longing
    for your laws at all times.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Remove from me their scorn and contempt,
    for I keep your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have chosen the way of faithfulness;
    I have set my heart on your laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Fulfill your promise to your servant,
    so that you may be feared.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Take away the disgrace I dread,
    for your laws are good.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
then I can answer anyone who taunts me,
    for I trust in your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will always obey your law,
    for ever and ever.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will speak of your statutes before kings
    and will not be put to shame,

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I reach out for your commands, which I love,
    that I may meditate on your decrees.
    ז Zayin

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The arrogant mock me unmercifully,
    but I do not turn from your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Indignation grips me because of the wicked,
    who have forsaken your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
In the night, Lord, I remember your name,
    that I may keep your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
This has been my practice:
    I obey your precepts.
    ח Heth

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God
Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The law from your mouth is more precious to me
    than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.
    י Yodh

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I know, Lord, that your laws are righteous,
    and that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May I wholeheartedly follow your decrees,
    that I may not be put to shame.
    כ Kaph

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My eyes fail, looking for your promise;
    I say, “When will you comfort me?”

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
In your unfailing love preserve my life,
    that I may obey the statutes of your mouth.
    ל Lamedh

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your word, Lord, is eternal;
    it stands firm in the heavens.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
If your law had not been my delight,
    I would have perished in my affliction.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
To all perfection I see a limit,
    but your commands are boundless.
    מ Mem

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Oh, how I love your law!
    I meditate on it all day long.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your commands are always with me
    and make me wiser than my enemies.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have kept my feet from every evil path
    so that I might obey your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your statutes are my heritage forever;
    they are the joy of my heart.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Uphold me, and I will be delivered;
    I will always have regard for your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross;
    therefore I love your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My eyes fail, looking for your salvation,
    looking for your righteous promise.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Direct my footsteps according to your word;
    let no sin rule over me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though I am lowly and despised,
    I do not forget your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I call with all my heart; answer me, Lord,
    and I will obey your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Hear my voice in accordance with your love;
    preserve my life, Lord, according to your laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Look on my suffering and deliver me,
    for I have not forgotten your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I rejoice in your promise
    like one who finds great spoil.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
they do no wrong
    but follow his ways.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
How can a young person stay on the path of purity?
    By living according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I meditate on your precepts
    and consider your ways.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Be good to your servant while I live,
    that I may obey your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I hold fast to your statutes, Lord;
    do not let me be put to shame.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Give me understanding, so that I may keep your law
    and obey it with all my heart.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Direct me in the path of your commands,
    for there I find delight.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Turn my heart toward your statutes
    and not toward selfish gain.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Turn my eyes away from worthless things;
    preserve my life according to your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Never take your word of truth from my mouth,
    for I have put my hope in your laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will walk about in freedom,
    for I have sought out your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
for I delight in your commands
    because I love them.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I remember, Lord, your ancient laws,
    and I find comfort in them.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your decrees are the theme of my song
    wherever I lodge.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have considered my ways
    and have turned my steps to your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will hasten and not delay
    to obey your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though the wicked bind me with ropes,
    I will not forget your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
At midnight I rise to give you thanks
    for your righteous laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I am a friend to all who fear you,
    to all who follow your precepts.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Before I was afflicted I went astray,
    but now I obey your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You are good, and what you do is good;
    teach me your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies,
    I keep your precepts with all my heart.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Their hearts are callous and unfeeling,
    but I delight in your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
It was good for me to be afflicted
    so that I might learn your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your hands made me and formed me;
    give me understanding to learn your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May those who fear you rejoice when they see me,
    for I have put my hope in your word.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke,
    I do not forget your decrees.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
All your commands are trustworthy;
    help me, for I am being persecuted without cause.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your laws endure to this day,
    for all things serve you.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I will never forget your precepts,
    for by them you have preserved my life.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your word is a lamp for my feet,
    a light on my path.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Though I constantly take my life in my hands,
    I will not forget your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My heart is set on keeping your decrees
    to the very end.
    ס Samekh

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I hate double-minded people,
    but I love your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Away from me, you evildoers,
    that I may keep the commands of my God!

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You reject all who stray from your decrees,
    for their delusions come to nothing.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I am your servant; give me discernment
    that I may understand your statutes.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
It is time for you to act, Lord;
    your law is being broken.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your statutes are wonderful;
    therefore I obey them.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
The unfolding of your words gives light;
    it gives understanding to the simple.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Streams of tears flow from my eyes,
    for your law is not obeyed.
    צ Tsadhe

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You are righteous, Lord,
    and your laws are right.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Your righteousness is everlasting
    and your law is true.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
My eyes stay open through the watches of the night,
    that I may meditate on your promises.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Yet you are near, Lord,
    and all your commands are true.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Defend my cause and redeem me;
    preserve my life according to your promise.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I hate and detest falsehood
    but I love your law.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I wait for your salvation, Lord,
    and I follow your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Seven times a day I praise you
    for your righteous laws.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Great peace have those who love your law,
    and nothing can make them stumble.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
May my supplication come before you;
    deliver me according to your promise.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
Let me live that I may praise you,
    and may your laws sustain me.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I obey your precepts and your statutes,
    for all my ways are known to you.
    ת Taw

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
I have strayed like a lost sheep.
    Seek your servant,
    for I have not forgotten your commands.

teaching.name: Psalm of praise to the word of God

content:
You, Lord, will keep the needy safe
    and will protect us forever from the wicked,

Help, Lord, for no one is faithful anymore;
    those who are loyal have vanished from the human race.

May the Lord silence all flattering lips
    and every boastful tongue—

And the words of the Lord are flawless,
    like silver purified in a crucible,
    like gold refined seven times.

“Because the poor are plundered and the needy groan,
    I will now arise,” says the Lord.
    “I will protect them from those who malign them.”

who freely strut about
    when what is vile is honored by the human race.

He will punish you with a warrior’s sharp arrows,
    with burning coals of the broom bush.

I am for peace;
    but when I speak, they are for war.

I call on the Lord in my distress,
    and he answers me.

Too long have I lived
    among those who hate peace.

Save me, Lord,
    from lying lips
    and from deceitful tongues.

What will he do to you,
    and what more besides,
    you deceitful tongue?

Woe to me that I dwell in Meshek,
    that I live among the tents of Kedar!

the sun will not harm you by day,
    nor the moon by night.

indeed, he who watches over Israel
    will neither slumber nor sleep.

The Lord watches over you—
    the Lord is your shade at your right hand;

the Lord will watch over your coming and going
    both now and forevermore.

I lift up my eyes to the mountains—
    where does my help come from?

My help comes from the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

He will not let your foot slip—
    he who watches over you will not slumber;

The Lord will keep you from all harm—
    he will watch over your life;

I rejoiced with those who said to me,
    “Let us go to the house of the Lord.”

There stand the thrones for judgment,
    the thrones of the house of David.

May there be peace within your walls
    and security within your citadels.”

For the sake of my family and friends,
    I will say, “Peace be within you.”

Jerusalem is built like a city
    that is closely compacted together.

Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
    “May those who love you be secure.

For the sake of the house of the Lord our God,
    I will seek your prosperity.

Our feet are standing
    in your gates, Jerusalem.

That is where the tribes go up—
    the tribes of the Lord—
  to praise the name of the Lord
    according to the statute given to Israel.

As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master,
    as the eyes of a female slave look to the hand of her mistress,
  so our eyes look to the Lord our God,
    till he shows us his mercy.

Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us,
    for we have endured no end of contempt.

I lift up my eyes to you,
    to you who sit enthroned in heaven.

We have endured no end
    of ridicule from the arrogant,
    of contempt from the proud.

If the Lord had not been on our side—
    let Israel say—

if the Lord had not been on our side
    when people attacked us,

they would have swallowed us alive
    when their anger flared against us;

the flood would have engulfed us,
    the torrent would have swept over us,

Our help is in the name of the Lord,
    the Maker of heaven and earth.

the raging waters
    would have swept us away.

Praise be to the Lord,
    who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

We have escaped like a bird
    from the fowler’s snare;
  the snare has been broken,
    and we have escaped.

Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion,
    which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

As the mountains surround Jerusalem,
    so the Lord surrounds his people
    both now and forevermore.

The scepter of the wicked will not remain
    over the land allotted to the righteous,
  for then the righteous might use
    their hands to do evil.

Lord, do good to those who are good,
    to those who are upright in heart.

But those who turn to crooked ways
    the Lord will banish with the evildoers.
    
  Peace be on Israel.

Our mouths were filled with laughter,
    our tongues with songs of joy.
  Then it was said among the nations,
    “The Lord has done great things for them.”

The Lord has done great things for us,
    and we are filled with joy.

Restore our fortunes, Lord,
    like streams in the Negev.

Those who sow with tears
    will reap with songs of joy.

Those who go out weeping,
    carrying seed to sow,
  will return with songs of joy,
    carrying sheaves with them.

When the Lord restored the fortunes of Zion,
    we were like those who dreamed.

Unless the Lord builds the house,
    the builders labor in vain.
  Unless the Lord watches over the city,
    the guards stand watch in vain.

In vain you rise early
    and stay up late,
  toiling for food to eat—
    for he grants sleep to those he loves.

Children are a heritage from the Lord,
    offspring a reward from him.

Like arrows in the hands of a warrior
    are children born in one’s youth.

Blessed is the man
    whose quiver is full of them.
  They will not be put to shame
    when they contend with their opponents in court.

Blessed are all who fear the Lord,
    who walk in obedience to him.

You will eat the fruit of your labor;
    blessings and prosperity will be yours.

May you live to see your children’s children—
    peace be on Israel.

Your wife will be like a fruitful vine
    within your house;
  your children will be like olive shoots
    around your table.

Yes, this will be the blessing
    for the man who fears the Lord.

“They have greatly oppressed me from my youth,”
    let Israel say;

“they have greatly oppressed me from my youth,
    but they have not gained the victory over me.

May they be like grass on the roof,
    which withers before it can grow;

Plowmen have plowed my back
    and made their furrows long.

a reaper cannot fill his hands with it,
    nor one who gathers fill his arms.

But the Lord is righteous;
    he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.”

May all who hate Zion
    be turned back in shame.

How long, Lord? Will you forget me forever?
    How long will you hide your face from me?

and my enemy will say, “I have overcome him,”
    and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

How long must I wrestle with my thoughts
    and day after day have sorrow in my heart?
    How long will my enemy triumph over me?

But I trust in your unfailing love;
    my heart rejoices in your salvation.

I will sing the Lord’s praise,
    for he has been good to me.

Look on me and answer, Lord my God.
    Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death,

But with you there is forgiveness,
    so that we can, with reverence, serve you.

I wait for the Lord, my whole being waits,
    and in his word I put my hope.

I wait for the Lord
    more than watchmen wait for the morning,
    more than watchmen wait for the morning.
Out of the depths I cry to you, Lord;

If you, Lord, kept a record of sins,
    Lord, who could stand?

He himself will redeem Israel
    from all their sins.

Lord, hear my voice.
  Let your ears be attentive
    to my cry for mercy.

Israel, put your hope in the Lord,
    for with the Lord is unfailing love
    and with him is full redemption.

My heart is not proud, Lord,
    my eyes are not haughty;
  I do not concern myself with great matters
    or things too wonderful for me.

Israel, put your hope in the Lord
    both now and forevermore.

“I will not enter my house
    or go to my bed,

till I find a place for the Lord,
    a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

‘Arise, Lord, and come to your resting place,
    you and the ark of your might.

May your priests be clothed with your righteousness;
    may your faithful people sing for joy.’ ”

“This is my resting place for ever and ever;
    here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it.

“Here I will make a horn grow for David
    and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

I will clothe his enemies with shame,
    but his head will be adorned with a radiant crown.”

He swore an oath to the Lord,
    he made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

We heard it in Ephrathah,
    we came upon it in the fields of Jaar:

For the Lord has chosen Zion,
    he has desired it for his dwelling, saying,

I will bless her with abundant provisions;
    her poor I will satisfy with food.

Lord, remember David
    and all his self-denial.

“Let us go to his dwelling place,
    let us worship at his footstool, saying,

If your sons keep my covenant
    and the statutes I teach them,
  then their sons will sit
    on your throne for ever and ever.”

I will allow no sleep to my eyes
    or slumber to my eyelids,

For the sake of your servant David,
    do not reject your anointed one.

The Lord swore an oath to David,
    a sure oath he will not revoke:
  “One of your own descendants
    I will place on your throne.

I will clothe her priests with salvation,
    and her faithful people will ever sing for joy.

It is as if the dew of Hermon
    were falling on Mount Zion.
  For there the Lord bestows his blessing,
    even life forevermore.

How good and pleasant it is
    when God’s people live together in unity!

It is like precious oil poured on the head,
    running down on the beard,
  running down on Aaron’s beard,
    down on the collar of his robe.

Praise the Lord, all you servants of the Lord
    who minister by night in the house of the Lord.

Lift up your hands in the sanctuary
    and praise the Lord.

May the Lord bless you from Zion,
    he who is the Maker of heaven and earth.

Praise the Lord, for the Lord is good;
    sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

Those who make them will be like them,
    and so will all who trust in them.

All you Israelites, praise the Lord;
    house of Aaron, praise the Lord;

I know that the Lord is great,
    that our Lord is greater than all gods.

He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,
    the firstborn of people and animals.

He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt,
    against Pharaoh and all his servants.

He struck down many nations
    and killed mighty kings—

Sihon king of the Amorites,
    Og king of Bashan,
    and all the kings of Canaan—

and he gave their land as an inheritance,
    an inheritance to his people Israel.

Your name, Lord, endures forever,
    your renown, Lord, through all generations.

For the Lord will vindicate his people
    and have compassion on his servants.

The idols of the nations are silver and gold,
    made by human hands.

They have mouths, but cannot speak,
    eyes, but cannot see.

Praise be to the Lord from Zion,
    to him who dwells in Jerusalem.
    
  Praise the Lord.

you who minister in the house of the Lord,
    in the courts of the house of our God.

For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own,
    Israel to be his treasured possession.

The Lord does whatever pleases him,
    in the heavens and on the earth,
    in the seas and all their depths.

They have ears, but cannot hear,
    nor is there breath in their mouths.

house of Levi, praise the Lord;
    you who fear him, praise the Lord.

to him who alone does great wonders,
    His love endures forever.

the moon and stars to govern the night;
    His love endures forever.

to him who led his people through the wilderness;
    His love endures forever.

to him who struck down great kings,
    His love endures forever.

He remembered us in our low estate
    His love endures forever.

and brought Israel out from among them
    His love endures forever.

Sihon king of the Amorites
    His love endures forever.

and gave their land as an inheritance,
    His love endures forever.

Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good.
    His love endures forever.

who by his understanding made the heavens,
    His love endures forever.

who made the great lights—
    His love endures forever.

to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt
    His love endures forever.

and brought Israel through the midst of it,
    His love endures forever.

and Og king of Bashan—
    His love endures forever.

an inheritance to his servant Israel.
    His love endures forever.

and freed us from our enemies.
    His love endures forever.

He gives food to every creature.
    His love endures forever.

Give thanks to the God of heaven.
    His love endures forever.

Give thanks to the God of gods.
    His love endures forever.

Give thanks to the Lord of lords:
    His love endures forever.

who spread out the earth upon the waters,
    His love endures forever.

the sun to govern the day,
    His love endures forever.

with a mighty hand and outstretched arm;
    His love endures forever.

to him who divided the Red Sea asunder
    His love endures forever.

but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea;
    His love endures forever.

and killed mighty kings—
    His love endures forever.

There on the poplars
    we hung our harps,

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land
Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
If I forget you, Jerusalem,
    may my right hand forget its skill.

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth
    if I do not remember you,
  if I do not consider Jerusalem
    my highest joy.

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept
    when we remembered Zion.

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
Daughter Babylon, doomed to destruction,
    happy is the one who repays you
    according to what you have done to us.

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
Happy is the one who seizes your infants
    and dashes them against the rocks.

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
How can we sing the songs of the Lord
    while in a foreign land?

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
Remember, Lord, what the Edomites did
    on the day Jerusalem fell.
  “Tear it down,” they cried,
    “tear it down to its foundations!”

teaching.name: Sing the Lords song in a foreign land

content:
I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart;
    before the “gods” I will sing your praise.

I will bow down toward your holy temple
    and will praise your name
    for your unfailing love and your faithfulness,
  for you have so exalted your solemn decree
    that it surpasses your fame.

May all the kings of the earth praise you, Lord,
    when they hear what you have decreed.

When I called, you answered me;
    you greatly emboldened me.

May they sing of the ways of the Lord,
    for the glory of the Lord is great.

Though the Lord is exalted, he looks kindly on the lowly;
    though lofty, he sees them from afar.

Though I walk in the midst of trouble,
    you preserve my life.
  You stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes;
    with your right hand you save me.

You have searched me, Lord,
    and you know me.

even there your hand will guide me,
    your right hand will hold me fast.

For you created my inmost being;
    you knit me together in my mother’s womb.

My frame was not hidden from you
    when I was made in the secret place,
    when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.

They speak of you with evil intent;
    your adversaries misuse your name.

Do I not hate those who hate you, Lord,
    and abhor those who are in rebellion against you?

You know when I sit and when I rise;
    you perceive my thoughts from afar.

Where can I go from your Spirit?
    Where can I flee from your presence?

If I go up to the heavens, you are there;
    if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me
    and the light become night around me,”

Were I to count them,
    they would outnumber the grains of sand—
    when I awake, I am still with you.

I have nothing but hatred for them;
    I count them my enemies.

Search me, God, and know my heart;
    test me and know my anxious thoughts.

You discern my going out and my lying down;
    you are familiar with all my ways.

Before a word is on my tongue
    you, Lord, know it completely.

Such knowledge is too wonderful for me,
    too lofty for me to attain.

If I rise on the wings of the dawn,
    if I settle on the far side of the sea,

How precious to me are your thoughts, God!
    How vast is the sum of them!

If only you, God, would slay the wicked!
    Away from me, you who are bloodthirsty!

See if there is any offensive way in me,
    and lead me in the way everlasting.

You hem me in behind and before,
    and you lay your hand upon me.

Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion!
    When the Lord restores his people,
    let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor,
    but the Lord is their refuge.

The fool says in his heart,
    “There is no God.”
  They are corrupt, their deeds are vile;
    there is no one who does good.

The Lord looks down from heaven
    on all mankind
  to see if there are any who understand,
    any who seek God.

But there they are, overwhelmed with dread,
    for God is present in the company of the righteous.

Rescue me, Lord, from evildoers;
    protect me from the violent,

I say to the Lord, “You are my God.”
    Hear, Lord, my cry for mercy.

Sovereign Lord, my strong deliverer,
    you shield my head in the day of battle.

They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent’s;
    the poison of vipers is on their lips.

May slanderers not be established in the land;
    may disaster hunt down the violent.

I know that the Lord secures justice for the poor
    and upholds the cause of the needy.

who devise evil plans in their hearts
    and stir up war every day.

Do not grant the wicked their desires, Lord;
    do not let their plans succeed.

Those who surround me proudly rear their heads;
    may the mischief of their lips engulf them.

Surely the righteous will praise your name,
    and the upright will live in your presence.

May my prayer be set before you like incense;
    may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

Let a righteous man strike me—that is a kindness;
    let him rebuke me—that is oil on my head.
  My head will not refuse it,
    for my prayer will still be against the deeds of evildoers.

They will say, “As one plows and breaks up the earth,
    so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave.”

I call to you, Lord, come quickly to me;
    hear me when I call to you.

Let the wicked fall into their own nets,
    while I pass by in safety.

Set a guard over my mouth, Lord;
    keep watch over the door of my lips.

Do not let my heart be drawn to what is evil
    so that I take part in wicked deeds
  along with those who are evildoers;
    do not let me eat their delicacies.

Their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs,
    and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

But my eyes are fixed on you, Sovereign Lord;
    in you I take refuge—do not give me over to death.

Keep me safe from the traps set by evildoers,
    from the snares they have laid for me.

When my spirit grows faint within me,
    it is you who watch over my way.
  In the path where I walk
    people have hidden a snare for me.

I pour out before him my complaint;
    before him I tell my trouble.

Listen to my cry,
    for I am in desperate need;
  rescue me from those who pursue me,
    for they are too strong for me.

I cry aloud to the Lord;
    I lift up my voice to the Lord for mercy.

Set me free from my prison,
    that I may praise your name.
  Then the righteous will gather about me
    because of your goodness to me.

The enemy pursues me,
    he crushes me to the ground;
  he makes me dwell in the darkness
    like those long dead.

Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love,
    for I have put my trust in you.
  Show me the way I should go,
    for to you I entrust my life.

Do not bring your servant into judgment,
    for no one living is righteous before you.

Rescue me from my enemies, Lord,
    for I hide myself in you.

Teach me to do your will,
    for you are my God;
  may your good Spirit
    lead me on level ground.

Lord, hear my prayer,
    listen to my cry for mercy;
  in your faithfulness and righteousness
    come to my relief.

So my spirit grows faint within me;
    my heart within me is dismayed.

I spread out my hands to you;
    I thirst for you like a parched land.

Answer me quickly, Lord;
    my spirit fails.
  Do not hide your face from me
    or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

For your name’s sake, Lord, preserve my life;
    in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

Part your heavens, Lord, and come down;
    touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

Send forth lightning and scatter the enemy;
    shoot your arrows and rout them.

I will sing a new song to you, my God;
    on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,

Then our sons in their youth
    will be like well-nurtured plants,
  and our daughters will be like pillars
    carved to adorn a palace.

whose mouths are full of lies,
    whose right hands are deceitful.

our oxen will draw heavy loads.
  There will be no breaching of walls,
    no going into captivity,
    no cry of distress in our streets.

Our barns will be filled
    with every kind of provision.
  Our sheep will increase by thousands,
    by tens of thousands in our fields;

Blessed is the people of whom this is true;
    blessed is the people whose God is the Lord.

Praise be to the Lord my Rock,
    who trains my hands for war,
    my fingers for battle.

He is my loving God and my fortress,
    my stronghold and my deliverer,
  my shield, in whom I take refuge,
    who subdues peoples under me.

Lord, what are human beings that you care for them,
    mere mortals that you think of them?

They are like a breath;
    their days are like a fleeting shadow.

to the One who gives victory to kings,
    who delivers his servant David.
    
  From the deadly sword

deliver me;
    rescue me from the hands of foreigners
  whose mouths are full of lies,
    whose right hands are deceitful.

All your works praise you, Lord;
    your faithful people extol you.

They tell of the glory of your kingdom
    and speak of your might,

The eyes of all look to you,
    and you give them their food at the proper time.

The Lord is righteous in all his ways
    and faithful in all he does.

One generation commends your works to another;
    they tell of your mighty acts.

They celebrate your abundant goodness
    and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

The Lord is gracious and compassionate,
    slow to anger and rich in love.

so that all people may know of your mighty acts
    and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

The Lord upholds all who fall
    and lifts up all who are bowed down.

He fulfills the desires of those who fear him;
    he hears their cry and saves them.

They speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty—
    and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

They tell of the power of your awesome works—
    and I will proclaim your great deeds.

The Lord is good to all;
    he has compassion on all he has made.

My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord.
    Let every creature praise his holy name
    for ever and ever.

I will exalt you, my God the King;
    I will praise your name for ever and ever.

Every day I will praise you
    and extol your name for ever and ever.

Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise;
    his greatness no one can fathom.

Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom,
    and your dominion endures through all generations.
    
  The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises
    and faithful in all he does.

You open your hand
    and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

The Lord is near to all who call on him,
    to all who call on him in truth.

The Lord watches over all who love him,
    but all the wicked he will destroy.

Do not put your trust in princes,
    in human beings, who cannot save.

The Lord watches over the foreigner
    and sustains the fatherless and the widow,
    but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

The Lord reigns forever,
    your God, O Zion, for all generations.
    
  Praise the Lord.

When their spirit departs, they return to the ground;
    on that very day their plans come to nothing.

Praise the Lord.
    
  Praise the Lord, my soul.

I will praise the Lord all my life;
    I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

Blessed are those whose help is the God of Jacob,
    whose hope is in the Lord their God.

He is the Maker of heaven and earth,
    the sea, and everything in them—
    he remains faithful forever.

He upholds the cause of the oppressed
    and gives food to the hungry.
  The Lord sets prisoners free,

the Lord gives sight to the blind,
  the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down,
    the Lord loves the righteous.

Sing to the Lord with grateful praise;
    make music to our God on the harp.

He sends his word and melts them;
    he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

Praise the Lord.
    
  How good it is to sing praises to our God,
    how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

The Lord builds up Jerusalem;
    he gathers the exiles of Israel.

He provides food for the cattle
    and for the young ravens when they call.

His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse,
    nor his delight in the legs of the warrior;

the Lord delights in those who fear him,
    who put their hope in his unfailing love.

Extol the Lord, Jerusalem;
    praise your God, Zion.

He strengthens the bars of your gates
    and blesses your people within you.

He sends his command to the earth;
    his word runs swiftly.

He spreads the snow like wool
    and scatters the frost like ashes.

He hurls down his hail like pebbles.
    Who can withstand his icy blast?

He has revealed his word to Jacob,
    his laws and decrees to Israel.

He heals the brokenhearted
    and binds up their wounds.

He determines the number of the stars
    and calls them each by name.

The Lord sustains the humble
    but casts the wicked to the ground.

He grants peace to your borders
    and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

Great is our Lord and mighty in power;
    his understanding has no limit.

Praise him, sun and moon;
    praise him, all you shining stars.

lightning and hail, snow and clouds,
    stormy winds that do his bidding,

you mountains and all hills,
    fruit trees and all cedars,

Praise him, all his angels;
    praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

and he established them for ever and ever—

kings of the earth and all nations,
    you princes and all rulers on earth,

young men and women,
    old men and children.

wild animals and all cattle,
    small creatures and flying birds,

And he has raised up for his people a horn,
    the praise of all his faithful servants,
    of Israel, the people close to his heart.
    
  Praise the Lord.

Praise him, you highest heavens
    and you waters above the skies.

Let them praise the name of the Lord,
    for at his command they were created,

Praise the Lord from the earth,
    you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

to carry out the sentence written against them—
    this is the glory of all his faithful people.
    
  Praise the Lord.

Praise the Lord.
    
  Sing to the Lord a new song,
    his praise in the assembly of his faithful people.

Let them praise his name with dancing
    and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

For the Lord takes delight in his people;
    he crowns the humble with victory.

to inflict vengeance on the nations
    and punishment on the peoples,

May the praise of God be in their mouths
    and a double-edged sword in their hands,

Let Israel rejoice in their Maker;
    let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

Let his faithful people rejoice in this honor
    and sing for joy on their beds.

to bind their kings with fetters,
    their nobles with shackles of iron,

Lord, who may dwell in your sacred tent?
    Who may live on your holy mountain?

who lends money to the poor without interest;
    who does not accept a bribe against the innocent.
    
  Whoever does these things
    will never be shaken.

praise him with the clash of cymbals,
    praise him with resounding cymbals.

Let everything that has breath praise the Lord.
    
  Praise the Lord.

Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet,
    praise him with the harp and lyre,

praise him with timbrel and dancing,
    praise him with the strings and pipe,

Praise him for his acts of power;
    praise him for his surpassing greatness.

Keep me safe, my God,
    for in you I take refuge.

The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places;
    surely I have a delightful inheritance.

I keep my eyes always on the Lord.
    With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

Those who run after other gods will suffer more and more.
    I will not pour out libations of blood to such gods
    or take up their names on my lips.

Lord, you alone are my portion and my cup;
    you make my lot secure.

I say of the holy people who are in the land,
    “They are the noble ones in whom is all my delight.”

I will praise the Lord, who counsels me;
    even at night my heart instructs me.

Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices;
    my body also will rest secure,

I say to the Lord, “You are my Lord;
    apart from you I have no good thing.”

because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead,
    nor will you let your faithful one see decay.

Hear me, Lord, my plea is just;
    listen to my cry.
  Hear my prayer—
    it does not rise from deceitful lips.

Show me the wonders of your great love,
    you who save by your right hand
    those who take refuge in you from their foes.

from the wicked who are out to destroy me,
    from my mortal enemies who surround me.

They close up their callous hearts,
    and their mouths speak with arrogance.

They are like a lion hungry for prey,
    like a fierce lion crouching in cover.

Though you probe my heart,
    though you examine me at night and test me,
  you will find that I have planned no evil;
    my mouth has not transgressed.

Rise up, Lord, confront them, bring them down;
    with your sword rescue me from the wicked.

Though people tried to bribe me,
    I have kept myself from the ways of the violent
    through what your lips have commanded.

My steps have held to your paths;
    my feet have not stumbled.

They have tracked me down, they now surround me,
    with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

Let my vindication come from you;
    may your eyes see what is right.

I call on you, my God, for you will answer me;
    turn your ear to me and hear my prayer.

Keep me as the apple of your eye;
    hide me in the shadow of your wings

By your hand save me from such people, Lord,
    from those of this world whose reward is in this life.
  May what you have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies;
    may their children gorge themselves on it,
    and may there be leftovers for their little ones.

As for me, I will be vindicated and will see your face;
    when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

He shot his arrows and scattered the enemy,
    with great bolts of lightning he routed them.

The valleys of the sea were exposed
    and the foundations of the earth laid bare
  at your rebuke, Lord,
    at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

He rescued me from my powerful enemy,
    from my foes, who were too strong for me.

They confronted me in the day of my disaster,
    but the Lord was my support.

All his laws are before me;
    I have not turned away from his decrees.

I have been blameless before him
    and have kept myself from sin.

It is God who arms me with strength
    and keeps my way secure.

You provide a broad path for my feet,
    so that my ankles do not give way.

I crushed them so that they could not rise;
    they fell beneath my feet.

foreigners cower before me;
    as soon as they hear of me, they obey me.

Therefore I will praise you, Lord, among the nations;
    I will sing the praises of your name.

I called to the Lord, who is worthy of praise,
    and I have been saved from my enemies.

The cords of the grave coiled around me;
    the snares of death confronted me.

The Lord thundered from heaven;
    the voice of the Most High resounded.

For I have kept the ways of the Lord;
    I am not guilty of turning from my God.

You save the humble
    but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

With your help I can advance against a troop;
    with my God I can scale a wall.

He trains my hands for battle;
    my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

You made my enemies turn their backs in flight,
    and I destroyed my foes.

I beat them as fine as windblown dust;
    I trampled them like mud in the streets.

He parted the heavens and came down;
    dark clouds were under his feet.

He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him—
    the dark rain clouds of the sky.

He reached down from on high and took hold of me;
    he drew me out of deep waters.

The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness;
    according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
    according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

to the pure you show yourself pure,
    but to the devious you show yourself shrewd.

You, Lord, keep my lamp burning;
    my God turns my darkness into light.

He makes my feet like the feet of a deer;
    he causes me to stand on the heights.

They cried for help, but there was no one to save them—
    to the Lord, but he did not answer.

They all lose heart;
    they come trembling from their strongholds.

He is the God who avenges me,
    who subdues nations under me,
I love you, Lord, my strength.

The cords of death entangled me;
    the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

He mounted the cherubim and flew;
    he soared on the wings of the wind.

Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced,
    with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

He brought me out into a spacious place;
    he rescued me because he delighted in me.

To the faithful you show yourself faithful,
    to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

For who is God besides the Lord?
    And who is the Rock except our God?

I pursued my enemies and overtook them;
    I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

You armed me with strength for battle;
    you humbled my adversaries before me.

The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock!
    Exalted be God my Savior!

Day after day they pour forth speech;
    night after night they reveal knowledge.

They have no speech, they use no words;
    no sound is heard from them.

Yet their voice goes out into all the earth,
    their words to the ends of the world.
  In the heavens God has pitched a tent for the sun.

The precepts of the Lord are right,
    giving joy to the heart.
  The commands of the Lord are radiant,
    giving light to the eyes.

By them your servant is warned;
    in keeping them there is great reward.

Keep your servant also from willful sins;
    may they not rule over me.
  Then I will be blameless,
    innocent of great transgression.

May these words of my mouth and this meditation of my heart
    be pleasing in your sight,
    Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer.

They are more precious than gold,
    than much pure gold;
  they are sweeter than honey,
    than honey from the honeycomb.

But who can discern their own errors?
    Forgive my hidden faults.

The heavens declare the glory of God;
    the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

It is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,
    like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

The law of the Lord is perfect,
    refreshing the soul.
  The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy,
    making wise the simple.

The fear of the Lord is pure,
    enduring forever.
  The decrees of the Lord are firm,
    and all of them are righteous.

The kings of the earth rise up
    and the rulers band together
    against the Lord and against his anointed, saying,

He rebukes them in his anger
    and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

“Let us break their chains
    and throw off their shackles.”

“I have installed my king
    on Zion, my holy mountain.”

Therefore, you kings, be wise;
    be warned, you rulers of the earth.

Serve the Lord with fear
    and celebrate his rule with trembling.

Kiss his son, or he will be angry
    and your way will lead to your destruction,
  for his wrath can flare up in a moment.
    Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

Why do the nations conspire
    and the peoples plot in vain?

The One enthroned in heaven laughs;
    the Lord scoffs at them.

Ask me,
    and I will make the nations your inheritance,
    the ends of the earth your possession.

You will break them with a rod of iron;

May the Lord answer you when you are in distress;
